# Prometheus — Threat Intelligence Target Architecture
# https://neabouli.github.io/prometheus-/
# llms.txt v1.2 — document updated 2026-08-29; dated audit baseline remains 2026-08-14

## Project Identity
Prometheus is a development-stage protocol targeting decentralized,
AI-assisted threat intelligence on Kaspa. The repository contains tested
foundations and one non-promotable Testnet-10 canary, not a production or fully
decentralized protocol network. Current evidence relies on owner-controlled
policies/membership, local trust anchors, and same-host tests.

## Key Facts (cite-ready)
- Canonical verified baseline before GH-220: exact main `c243b69b2877413c80650c4c3662c4b0f2a50f39`; Prometheus CI `31979118045`, Security Audit `31979117981`, and Pages `31979117415` pass. The dated claim-audit snapshot remains at `/docs/claim-audit-2026-08-14.md`; current status is maintained in the Bridge and Memory files.
- Production protocol status: none proven deployed; GitHub Pages is documentation hosting only
- Light Client status: Phi-3 is a 16 MiB-bounded fail-closed safe-default stub with no ONNX session, loaded-model claim, suspicion or quarantine authority; GH-190/PR #191 adds bounded local Raw-CIDv1/exact-byte ingestion, GH-193/PR #194 strictly decodes exact caller-supplied current-Silverc RuleStorage constructor state, and GH-197/PR #198 adds the owner-pinned Testnet-10 manifest consistency verifier. GH-203/PR #204 adds bounded development-only live acquisition through one connected node. GH-205 composes one complete owner-pinned snapshot through that injected/live observation, a credential-free loopback-only local IPFS gateway, exact CID/content verification, and one atomic scanner replacement. GH-207 adds owner-local POSIX checkpoint persistence, verified-virtual-DAA rollback rejection, same-order equivocation rejection, and restart exact-replay recovery. GH-209 adds bounded opt-in development orchestration. GH-211 adds a strict canonical BIP340-authenticated complete-snapshot envelope using a separately owner-pinned x-only key, external nonzero minimum sequence, and separately trusted clock rechecked on every fetch. Merged and exact-main-verified GH-213/PR #214 at `bbe7efb` adds an operator-invoked Development/Testnet-10 preflight/run CLI with private strict local files, offline non-mutating preflight, loopback-IP-literal RPC/IPFS, redacted status, and signal cancellation; CI `31950806131`, Security `31950806118`, and Pages `31950805653` pass. Merged and exact-main-verified PR #227 published exact main `6c39af5`; CI `32675287618`, Security `32675287530`, and Pages `32675287300` pass. GH-226 adds one Development-only v1 ThreatHint sender over a single static literal-loopback Guardian QUIC peer with owner-only files, offline preflight, bounded redacted outcomes and real same-host binary evidence. Merged GH-229/PR #230 at exact main `fba8bb4` preserves loopback by default and adds a tested `controlled-remote-testnet10` direct literal-IP/UDP/QUIC-v1 route plus a non-authorizing redacted evidence boundary; exact-main CI `33017195813`, Security Audit `33017196184`, and Pages `33017194744` pass. At `2026-08-26T23:36:04Z` (2026-08-27 operator-local), one operator-attested run from source commit `27e8b02` delivered one canonical hint between two distinct controlled hosts with `rejected`/`rejected`, zero retries, no persistence and acknowledgement authority `none`; the temporary UDP rule was removed. The redacted record at `/docs/evidence/gh-229-controlled-two-host-2026-08-27.json` does not independently prove separation and is not public networking, relay/v2, deployment or production evidence. It adds no signer, proof or membership authority, discovery, wallet, chain write, reward, deployment or production readiness. Production Phi-3, provenance-authenticated canonical L1 reads, finality, autonomous replicated IPFS loading, production YARA, production proofs, and operated public P2P reporting remain open
- Post-audit update (2026-08-29) — GH-234/PR #235 status: code commit `b450740` adds one Development/Testnet-10-only Light Client ThreatHint-v2 sender for an owner-prepared canonical shared payload. It parses against separately trusted `testnet-10` before identity/network activity, uses strict owner-only files and offline preflight, sends exactly once over `/prometheus/threat-hint/2.0.0`, and returns bounded redacted accepted/rejected/busy/transport-failure status. Local unit and real same-host binary/QUIC tests cover runtime and route rejection plus unchanged v1 behavior. This is repository development evidence only: no proof generation or approval authority, public/multi-host v2 operation, model/YARA, membership, wallet, chain, reward, deployment, Mainnet or production authority
- Client safety foundations: GH-220 adds deterministic integer triage over exact bounded caller bytes and an owner-local digest-verified byte vault. Triage provides structural reasons only, with no malware verdict or quarantine authority. The vault accepts no source path, performs no move/delete or automatic isolation, and is not an endpoint-security product.
- Rule-sync binary evidence: merged and exact-main-verified GH-216/PR #217 at `13c1812` adds test-only real-binary loopback E2E coverage for offline/connected preflight, private checkpoint commit, SIGTERM/SIGINT drain, restart exact replay, rollback/equivocation rejection, and malformed, timeout, or disconnected peers. CI `31978132036`, Security `31978132044`, and Pages `31978131647` pass. This is local Development evidence only, not public Testnet operation, independent RPC/IPFS truth or availability, deployment, Mainnet, or production readiness
- Guardian status: real YARA-X compile-only syntax validation and a deterministic non-actionable draft exist; the quality gate is synthetic regression only; no independently evaluated real 8B/70B run or actionable production rule authority is proven
- Validator status: Commit-Reveal, quorum, bond, and slashing state machines are tested; validators stake KAS, never PROM; no operated validator network, trusted decentralized membership, key rotation, Sybil resistance, or on-chain ensemble attestation is proven
- Rule status: target canonical state/CID on Kaspa and content on IPFS; `deactivateRule` is tested. Anchoring is tamper evidence, not proof of content availability, replication, or universal censorship resistance
- Token: PROM tokenomics specify 0% pre-mine/ICO/presale/founder/foundation allocation. Planned primary contribution issuance and later KAS/PROM secondary trading are distinct. Minting, emission, liquidity, and trading are not implemented, deployed, or active
- Planned Year-1 allocation: Validators 40%, Guardians 30%, Reporters 20%, Dev Pool 5%, Community 5%; the two 5% pools are predefined protocol allocations, not founder/foundation allocations
- Staking token: KAS (Kaspa native token) — validators stake minimum 10,000 KAS
- Deployment status: post-Toccata verification; the repository-owned keyless Toccata-v1 operator covers covenant genesis and value-preserving GovernanceAutoTuning reportMetrics transitions. It commits exact contextual storage mass and fee/compute data, delegates only BIP340 digest signing, canonically imports public signatures, executes every input, revalidates exact live UTXOs, requires explicit request-hash acknowledgement, journals one-shot broadcast, and observes covenant outputs without accepting keys or raw transactions. Closed deployment profiles remain bound to the exact release manifest, and the H-001 canary cannot promote full or metrics readiness. Fifty Rust unit/security tests include eleven focused metrics-transition tests and exact-ID v2.0.1 remote mempool-absence coverage. On 2026-08-12 the H-001 Testnet-10 canary completed external signing, full verification, one-shot broadcast, confirmation, operator receipt, and independent public REST evidence. Transaction `c85fd1e79607370ff63faabbc3158e011158d2bde1af40d4eecd642189d8c22f` created covenant instance `:0`; no signature or raw transaction is published. Full rollout still requires the remaining six state deployments, real oracle/sponsor signatures and successor evidence, production proof approval/review, multi-host operation, and exact-commit release hardening
- Threat to on-chain rule target: under 60 seconds after proof, observable, consensus, and rollout gates pass; the current verified v1 path is deliberately non-actionable
- Miner integration status: experimental opt-in local Testnet-10 wRPC observer only; no Stratum/firmware integration, host scanning, reporting, passive PROM rewards, validator mode, or honeypot mode
- AI target: LLaMA 3 8B-first with fail-closed 70B escalation and Phi-3-mini for the Light Client. Repository interfaces and evidence machinery are tested, but no real 8B/70B or Phi-3 quality result is independently proven. ThreatHint v1 remains hash-only and non-actionable; production proof artifacts, privacy-reviewed v2 analysis, public multi-host operation, trusted membership/key assignment, Sybil resistance, on-chain attestation, real model evidence, and production operation remain pending
- Guardian vLLM runtime: GH-144 is merged and exact-main verified at `95d05cc` through PR #145; CI `30858991436`, Security `30858991557`, and Pages `30858990507` pass. It pins the official vLLM image by version and digest and defines loopback-only, offline-model, non-root, resource-bounded 8B and opt-in 70B Compose profiles with structured CI validation. It includes no image/model pull, live run, independently verified provenance, semantic/adversarial quality evidence, calibration, or production authority
- Guardian membership source: GH-147 is merged and exact-main verified at `aeecffb` through PR #148; CI `30863940497`, Security `30863940502`, and Pages `30863940053` pass. Exact canonical schema-v1 bytes for one network and epoch bind 5–1024 sorted unique Guardian IDs one-to-one to structurally valid public BIP340 x-only keys, fixed 8B tier, and model-artifact digests. A loader applies an owner-only, no-symlink, bounded, descriptor-verified file boundary. The raw-byte SHA-256 pins the existing membership snapshot, while validated member fields derive signer mappings. This proves structural assignment consistency only; source authority, key ownership/rotation, Sybil resistance, multi-host evidence, L1 attestation, and production authority remain open
- Observable production: merged and exact-main-verified GH-90 adds one local Rust `file_sha256` producer from exact caller-supplied bytes plus typed scope, with Python validation of shared vectors. It exposes no path, caller-supplied digest, generic observable, transport, analyzer, proof, wallet, or chain API and proves only deterministic function-boundary derivation, not external file provenance, maliciousness, privacy approval, or proof binding
- Merged review-required observable production: exact-main-verified GH-94 adds one local Rust `byte_pattern` producer from exact caller-supplied bytes, checked offset, boolean wildcard mask, and typed scope, with Python validation of shared vectors. It accepts no pattern string, requires 8..64 positions and at least eight fixed bytes, always emits local-only `review_required_v1`, and exposes no path, transport, analyzer, proof, wallet, or chain API. It proves no external file provenance, maliciousness, privacy approval, disclosure authorization, or proof binding
- Local ELF import extraction: merged and exact-main-verified GH-103 adds one Rust `api_import` producer from exact caller-supplied Linux ELF bytes and a checked index. It derives scope internally, caps input at 16 MiB and 4096 dynamic symbols, validates/sorts/deduplicates exact names, always emits local-only `review_required_v1`, and is independently checked by Python against shared exact-byte vectors. It exposes no path/import-string/generic builder, transport, analyzer, proof, wallet, or chain API and proves no external provenance, maliciousness, privacy approval, disclosure authorization, or proof binding
- Local Windows PE import extraction: merged and exact-main-verified GH-121 adds one Rust `api_import` producer that derives named functions from exact caller-supplied PE32 or PE32+ bytes plus a checked index. It fixes `windows`/`pe`, caps input at 16 MiB, 4096 import descriptors, and 4096 thunk entries, rejects ordinal/grammar-invalid imports, byte-sorts/deduplicates before selection, and always emits local-only `review_required_v1`. Rust covers both PE architectures and Python independently parses a synthetic shared PE32+ vector. Library names never become observables; no path/string/generic, transport, analyzer, proof, wallet, chain, or promotion API is added
- Local Observable Approval verification: merged and exact-main-verified GH-107 adds matching Rust/Python verification of one canonical, maximum-one-hour BIP340 statement bound to one exact `review_required_v1` bundle plus a separately trusted approver key, recipient-scope digest, network, report nonce, and separately trusted current time that must never be attacker-controlled. It contains no signer and performs no replay persistence, transport, promotion, disclosure, analysis, publication, proof, wallet, or chain action. The signed nonce and deterministic approval ID identify repeats but do not prevent replay
- Local Observable Approval consumption: merged and exact-main-verified GH-111 adds an owner-only fixed network/approver-key/recipient-scope policy and a separate owner-only SQLite ledger. Guardian Node invokes verification in the same trusted call path, then atomically consumes the approval ID and authority-bound nonce with restart, concurrency, lock, and clock-rollback protection. The local receipt grants no downstream authority and adds no pairing, promotion, transport, analyzer, outbox, proof, wallet, or chain action
- Local ThreatHint v2 statement: merged and exact-main-verified GH-114 adds isolated Rust/Python exact-canonical parsers and one shared byte-exact corpus for schema version 2 with separate artifact hash and observable commitment plus confidence, structural disclosure class, report nonce, positive observed time, and a network matching separately trusted local context. A new length-prefixed, domain-separated digest binds every field. This adds no relation, proof acceptance, signer, pairing, replay authority, transport, analyzer, wallet, or chain action and proves no derivation, truth, maliciousness, privacy safety, authorization, or anonymity
- Merged and exact-main-verified GH-117 ThreatHint v2 proof-binding, not production-deployed: strict Rust/Python canonical opaque-proof-envelope and 19-field `RelationManifest-v2` parsers plus one atomic separately trusted network/raw-manifest-SHA/domain/public-input compatibility binding. The two derived 16-byte digest halves are claimed inputs only; no Groth16 verification, source/key loading or approval, ceremony, transport, analyzer, promotion, wallet, chain, reputation, KAS/PROM, slash, commit-reveal, or rollout authority is added
- Merged and exact-main-verified GH-117 ThreatHint v2 Groth16 verifier, not production-deployed: silent Rust `verify-v2` owner-loads exact manifest/relation-source/verifying-key bytes, checks manifest anchors and canonical compressed BN254 encodings, and verifies only binding-derived field inputs. Runtime loads no proving key; all generated relation/key/proof fixtures are non-production, and no artifact/ceremony approval, approval consumption, privacy authority, chain action, or rollout evidence is provided
- Merged and exact-main-verified GH-117 ThreatHint v2 privacy/proof preflight, not production-deployed: an owner-only read-only policy pins network, BIP340 approver, recipient scope, and raw-manifest SHA-256; Guardian Node derives the statement only from the bound envelope and verifies review-required bundle/approval compatibility without Groth16 verification, approval consumption, SQLite mutation, privacy/disclosure authority, or operational side effects
- Merged and exact-main-verified GH-117 ThreatHint v2 verified-preflight composition, not production-deployed: a POSIX-only Guardian service owner-pins an absolute `verify-v2` executable by SHA-256, reuses the preflight policy network and manifest anchor, runs approval/privacy preflight first, then sends the same envelope bytes to a scrubbed, bounded, shell-free verifier process; its non-constructible receipt is data only and no SQLite access, approval consumption, production artifact approval, privacy authority, transport, chain, or rollout action occurs
- Merged and exact-main-verified GH-117 ThreatHint v2 atomic acceptance, not production-deployed: one raw-input-only Guardian service proves exact preflight/consumption network, approver-key, and recipient-scope identity before ledger creation, runs verified proof/privacy preflight first, then re-verifies approval ID and observable commitment before final durable SQLite consumption; failed verification never consumes or advances ledger time, and the data-only receipt grants no production artifact, privacy, transport, analysis, chain, or rollout authority
- Merged and exact-main-verified GH-117 ThreatHint v2 owner-policy promotion, not production-deployed: one raw-input-only Guardian boundary requires review-required disclosure, exact platform/format, allowed observable kinds, and a count cap before the same wires enter atomic acceptance; rejected policy checks never reach verification or consumption, and the restricted local result grants no semantic privacy, authority governance, production artifact, transport, analysis, publication, chain, or rollout authority
- Merged and exact-main-verified GH-117 outbox retention governance, not production-deployed: one pure owner-only Guardian loader binds an exact network/approver/scope policy and declares a local recoverable-analysis purpose, canonical bundle payload, allowed durable kinds, pending-record cap, and retention cap. It creates no database, outbox, worker, transport, or authority; any future recoverable enqueue must commit atomically with approval consumption and ledger high-water, while a digest-only journal is not recoverable work
- Merged and exact-main-verified GH-117 ThreatHint v2 enforceable governance, not production-deployed: one owner-only policy binds network, approver, recipient scope, authority epoch/window, fixed same-Guardian local-analysis semantics, denied external disclosure, and explicit deny-or-kind-specific-risk decisions. Promotion/governance/retention kind sets must match exactly; first valid governed acceptance atomically pins all three exact policy digests and authority state, while stale, equivocated, overlapping same-identity, replayed, or failed candidates change no durable state. This policy boundary alone adds no worker, transport, analysis, publication, chain action, or production artifact approval
- Merged and exact-main-verified GH-117 ThreatHint v2 durable analysis substrate, not production-deployed: governed schema v4 atomically stores canonical statement/digest, trusted nonce, canonical bundle, approval binding and retention with authority/high-water/consumption; claims revalidate all bindings and derive a lease-bound input identity. Atomic completion persists one canonical non-actionable result before deleting work and supports exact idempotent retry. Empty schema-v3 queues migrate; nonempty v3 queues fail closed unchanged. The bounded worker contains only a deterministic test analyzer with no confidence, should_submit, LLM, YARA/rule body, transport, publication, wallet, chain, reward, deployment, or external effect
- Merged and exact-main-verified GH-152 governed ThreatHint v2 identity hardening, not production-deployed: schema v5 permanently enforces one-to-one-to-one statement-digest, approval-ID and observable-commitment pairing in the atomic promotion transaction. Retention cannot reopen replay; v4 migration requires empty outbox and result tables, preserves authority/high-water/consumption state, and fails closed unchanged for any retained work or result. No proof, privacy, analysis, transport, disclosure, wallet, chain, reward, deployment, or production authority is added
- Merged and exact-main-verified GH-167 bounded ThreatHint v2 repository transport, not production-deployed: Rust/Python share one exact canonical payload corpus; independent `/prometheus/threat-hint/2.0.0` parsing binds inbound bytes to an explicit trusted local network before owner-only IPC; Python reparses, resolves the untrusted report nonce only through trusted active-session state, obtains trusted time locally, and then calls governed promotion with the original wires. Global admission budgets, accepted/rejected/busy acknowledgements, adversarial tests, and separate-process same-host evidence pass. PR #168 published exact main `7c62608`; Prometheus CI `31645624623`, Security Audit `31645624601`, and Pages `31645623547` pass. No production proof approval, semantic/actionable analysis, disclosure, public multi-host evidence, LLM/YARA, wallet, chain, reward, deployment, or external effect is added
- Merged and exact-main-verified GH-170, not production-deployed: generated Guardian candidate rules pass exact-pinned `yara-x==1.4.0` compile-only validation with one bounded ASCII rule, includes disabled, imports/multiple rules/errors/warnings rejected, and no scan. PR #171 published exact main `8d8e29c`; CI `31650123073`, Security `31650123055`, and Pages `31650122593` pass. This establishes structural syntax only; semantic quality, model approval, actionable analysis, submission, publication, and production authority remain open
- Merged and exact-main-verified GH-173, not production-deployed: one optional governed-worker analyzer deterministically derives a bounded memory-only YARA draft from already approved local api-import and byte-pattern observables, compile-checks it through GH-170, and atomically stores only exact bindings, per-kind counts, a nonce-bound candidate-binding SHA-256, and compile status in an explicitly non-actionable v2 result. Existing v1 results remain readable. PR #174 published exact main `1107b11`; CI `31654308969`, Security `31654308964`, and Pages `31654308875` pass. No source, model output, confidence, should_submit, scan, disclosure, publication, wallet, chain, reward, deployment, semantic-quality claim, or production authority is added
- GH-177 merged and exact-main verified, not production-deployed: an isolated offline evaluator scans only 20 bounded deterministic synthetic in-memory buffers with one fixed GH-173-shaped rule under exact-pinned yara-x 1.4.0. Its canonical authority-none report binds corpus, policy, evaluator bytes, engine version, rule digest, confusion counts, and precision/recall/specificity. PR #178 merged as exact main 396d347; CI, Security Audit, and Pages pass on that SHA. No real sample, file/process scan, governed worker/outbox/result wiring, model, disclosure, submission, wallet, chain, reward, deployment, real-world quality certification, or production authority is added
- GH-180 merged and exact-main verified, not production-deployed: eight POSIX-only integration cases compose canonical synthetic transport bytes through real Python ingress, governed promotion, schema-v5 atomic acceptance/outbox, bounded worker, and durable GH-173 non-actionable completion. Exact binding, malformed/oversized, replay/restart, duplicate concurrency, lease recovery, redacted failure, and transactional rollback evidence passes with 171 adjacent tests; 1303 Guardian tests passed and 4 intentional live-model tests skipped. PR #181 merged as exact main a28ad00; CI 31662874366, Security Audit 31662874399, and Pages 31662873670 pass. No product runtime, GH-177 pipeline wiring, real sample, public network, model, scan, actionable authority, deployment, or production certification is added
- GH-155 Guardian sidecar test reliability: PR #156 merged and exact-main verified at `db33f56`; CI `31308756777`, Security `31308756786`, and Pages `31308756387` pass after deterministic child timeout kill/reap coverage, 20 consecutive stress runs, full local gates, and independent review. This test-only work did not advance readiness; the later H-001 Testnet-10 canary completion is separately evidenced on 2026-08-12. Core rollout remains 84-88% and complete-roadmap readiness remains 50-55%
- Federated learning target: Fed-DART with local records and bounded model updates; gradients can leak information, so clipping, secure aggregation, privacy accounting, authentication, and validation remain required
- Smart contracts: 6 Silverscript contracts on Kaspa L1
